Thanks for contributing. Briefly describe what you changed and why.

These checks apply to list entries. Remove any that do not apply to your change; documentation and CI fixes do not need a new entry.

- [ ] The entry is for current Bend (`bendlang/bend`, 2.0.x), not Bend 1 / HVM2
- [ ] The entry uses `- [Name](url) - Description.`, with an uppercase start and a final period
- [ ] For a new entry: one item, at the bottom of the relevant category
- [ ] The resource has usable documentation or a working example supporting the recommendation
- [ ] Added or changed links work, and any added or changed Hub import resolves to a published file
- [ ] The description reflects current features and meaningful limitations
